svg.aria-label: Master plan of Zero Mile International: six east-west runways in two triples, a midfield terminal with the Zero Mile Hall to the west, a central Mall and six concourses, remote stands, cargo and maintenance to the east.
svg.text: THE MALL · APM under the spine
Master plan · 6 runways · 220 contact gates + 152 remote stands · design peak 260 movements an hour
